dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Ritou Harbor is too cautious in guarding against outlanders but too lenient with Inazumans."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "As such, all you need to travel freely in and out of territories controlled by the Shogunate is a forged local document."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And it's not as if this is a difficult task."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: What kind of idiot would post this sort of information on a bulletin board...
